avis.texte: I have maturing sensitive combo skin and this product works great for me! I think it makes for an excellent dupe for the Drunk Elephant's multipeptide moisturizer, which is the reason I tried it to begin with. I wanted a more cost effective option. I really appreciate the application pump design which keeps things more sanitary and gives me more control of how much I use. I do think my forehead wrinkles have softened since using it, and it doesn't leave my combo skin greasy after. I like it!! :)
This product is PHENOMENAL not to oily and perfect for mature skin!
Love the feel, texture and hydration!! Works well under my sunscreen, also Naturium!

avis.titre: It pills on my skin so I wouldn't repurchase.
avis.texte: I have mature skin (56) and really wanted to love this. Although it does moisturize, I could only use it at night and never under makeup because it pilled up on my skin.

avis.titre: I would purchase this item again.
avis.texte: Leaves skin feeling soft and glowing. Lightweight, non-irritating and easy to use.

avis.titre: Works well for me if applied a.m. only
avis.texte: After using this for about a month on my combination skin, I'd recommend it with this note of caution. I use prescription retinoid at night. After 1-2 days, my skin seemed to shed more deeply than usual. My skin tone seemed less uneven, but my face was also too exfoliated, so I have stopped using it at night (I should have known better than to layer a Vitamin C product with my Rx skincare). Since then, I've settled into using this in the morning only, following it with sunscreen. To me, it's less of a "moisturizer" and more of a treatment product. I like that the formula has no scent. I also like that the slim flexible tube/pump packaging protects the product from light and air.

avis.titre: Made my skin dry red and peeling
avis.texte: I have oily to dry skin and read some reviews on here and thought I would try it. No thanks it looks like I'm sunburnt and my skin is irritated and peeling

I love Naturium products and was looking to add another moisturizer to my skincare routine and decided to give this a try, love it! Very moisturizing and little to no smell how I like. Great purchase.

I really wanted to like this product. It's not too heavy and I was looking for a light moisturizer that would work on my sensitive and somewhat dry aging skin. It applies nicely and smells pleasantly milky as I dispense it into my hand, but then the fragrance immediately turns fishy after I've applied it to my face. I've been using it for a month and not seen any visible improvement. It's not effective on my texture or wrinkles, so this product is not one that I will continue using.

I have tried many moisturizers and I have to be honest, this one has given me actual results and competes with glow recipe moisturizers. This product reduces my fine lines and also gives me glowing skin! You really cant beat this price point for the results you get.

I've been waiting to find a moisturizer that gives a youthful glow while diminishing fine lines. I've joined the double moisturizing trend and couldn't be happier! This is my first layer in the morning and the evening. Treat yourself! It's the best!
Affordable and light weight, but left me very oily even with a small amount used.

The moisturizer feels great on the skin, but when applying makeup over top it starts pilling and flaking. I wear it if I'm not going to be wearing makeup, but I will not wear it under my makeup again.
Love using this in the am, and both routines in the summer. Not my go-to winter nighttime routine moisturizer but is great besides that.
This product makes my eyes burn! I've used it for 4 days and couldn't figure out why my eyes burn so bad. It's getting take back to Ulta tomorrow. So sad
I have tried so many different brands in the past and this is the only one I will buy repetetively. Makes my skin feel so soft, moisturized and it is so gentle. I have eczema and this really helps.
since using this product people have complimented how good my skin looks!! i have combination skin and this moisturizer is the perfect consistency. love it!!!

I've been using this moisturizer for about 2 months now and I'm obsessed. It's lightweight but my face doesn't feel dry at the end of the day, and my face looks so much glowier than it did before. I do use it in conjunction with the multi-peptide advanced serum, so i also recommend that, but both have been working great. My skin is sensitive (i have rosacea), but i wouldn't say that it's the MOST sensitive out there if that is helpful to know. I don't react badly to things often, usually just acne if something doesn't agree with me. This has not been a problem for me.

avis.titre: It is exactly what everyone says about it
avis.texte: I like this very much.. It's very hydrating.. doesn't break me out. Not overly greasy.. no irritating scents.

avis.titre: Amazing, even for my picky skin
avis.texte: Lovely moisturizer and the texture is so luxurious. I have combo sensirice skin and this is one of the few that have made my soin so happy

First time I've used this moisturizer, I noticed a big pimple the next day, I didn't associate it with trying a new product, but after I used it again a week later, same thing happened. At this point I'm deciding that this product is not for me. I can't speak to if the product is actually a good moisturizer or not, due to discontinuing use to not risk more reactions, but just wanted to share my experience. Everyone's skin is different tho, so just like with everything, do your research, look at multiple sources, and consider the reliability of source and quality of information.

avis.titre: I have repurchased this product again & again
avis.texte: I purchased this the first time after seeing a recommendation from Nikki LaRose on her you tube channel. Works extremely well under makeup, absorbs quickly. The packaging insures that you are able to use all of the product easily.

I did a test patch on my forearm before I used this on my face and didn't have a reaction within the next 24 hours. I was excited to try it because the texture reminded me of Dieux's Air Angel moisturizer and that's one of my all time favorites. For some reason when I applied to my face after washing it, no other skincare added, it burned my skin so badly and caused immediate redness and irritation. It started flaring up my PD around my chin and nose badly. It also dries out my face SO badly. I have sensitive normal to dry skin. Bummed I had this reaction to it but it does seem to work for other people, just maybe not for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Just buy it, you wont regret this purchase :D
avis.texte: I dont typically write reviews but I have to say this is one of the only drugstore moisturizers that has actually made me see a difference in my skin and with the small amount of fine lines I have (still in my mid-20s lol). I was starting to break out using my heavier moisturizers due to the changing weather and wanted a lightweight moisturizer that still has an efficacious ingredient deck. Came across the Naturium peptide moisturizer and it exceeded my expectations! No harsh or artificial fragrance and the perfect lightweight moisturizer for summer
Love this product. It goes on great and absorbs quickly. Great size for travel as well.
This was the first Naturium product I started with years ago. Its not thick or thin, a perfect texture. I always feel completely moisturized and never greasy.
This is great for around the eyes. My fine lines and wrinkles are greatly reduced. It's now part of my routine along with the serum that I use under makeup .great product !

I have dry skin, so I find this to be a lightweight moisturizer on my skin. The texture is lovely, and I love the pump too!! My skin did not breakout after using it for 2 weeks, and it sits well under makeup! I only give it 4 stars because I would've liked it to be slightly more moisturizing for my dry skin, so I might just try the rich cream from this multi-peptide line.
I'm on my 5th tube of this moisturizer! I have dry skin, but this hydrates it so well. No issues with pilling under makeup. My skin drinks this up!!

avis.titre: I'm not sure if I would buy it again.
avis.texte: I don't know if it help my face because I need more moisturizer.
Amazing! On my third bottle and decided to get the jumbo size!

This moisturizer is now my favorite and I will be repurchasing!! No breakouts or burning sensation plus the formula is so smooth, I get excited just to use it😂 this plus the 3% niacinamide cleanser are now in my skincare rotation FOREVER

I have oily skin so didn't think this would be the best option, but I stand to be corrected! While I mostly use this in my nighttime routine, I've occasionally used it during the day and either way it's good! It's richer than my other moisturizers but it melts right into my skin and doesn't feel heavy or cause more oil.
I have been loving this product. It is really nourishing and hydrating for my dry skin.
I just love this powerhouse lightweight moisturizer! Pairing it with the complimenting serum is fantastic!
Probably the best all around moisturizer I have used. The only thing that would make it better would be adding the same encapsulated copper peptides that the rich cream has.
I like this - it's cosmetically elegant and pleasant to use. But it doesn't hydrate my normal skin, nor does it really give me lasting moisture. Just a meh.

I was hesitant to buy this as I can have sensitive skin. In their instrucitons they say to try it on the inside of your elbow or a spot on your neck overnight before applying to your whole face which I did (having no reaction). So far I am loving it paired with a heavier moisturizer over top (Im dry and need the extra moisture). If your sensitive doing a toner/serum before would probably help too. I have noticed my skin looking more plump!

avis.titre: Got rid of my flaky areas
avis.texte: I really like how this moisturizer makes my skin feel. After using it at night, I wake up with super soft skin. Doesn't feel too greasy either and my face is naturally oily.

1. I have no idea what people are talking about with smell. There is verh little smell. 2. She's a thick girl. I'm in my 40's and my skin has really changed. I was getting dry flaky spots and all the sudden, eczema on my eye lids and between my eyebrows?! I'd use hydrocortisone and it would go away, only to come back a while later. Since I've been using this for the last five months, I've not had it come back once. My skin is juicy and glowy. Dry patches gone. I WILL NEVER not use this. I'm so happy I tried it. My guess is the couple of reviews that said it irritated their skin, probably allergic to an ingredient. Always patch test a new product guys.

3 stars since i didn't notice any big differences at all. re bought 3 times as the texture feels great and i like to use it at night but i think i just need something richer due to my dry skin. never caused any issues and has good ingredients but didn't do much for me, so looking for a new alternative...

I had seen a few great reviews on this product. Unfortunately, after trying it for a week it left my skin red & flared up with bumps. My cheeks basically looked like a Nestlé crunch bar. I also didn't think my skin felt very moisturized after I had applied it. So I will be returning it.

avis.titre: It made me brake out and burned
avis.texte: I wanted to love this moisturizer…. I loved it for the first teo days then i got horable acne and my gace burned. I had to stop using it and I switched back to my ushual

I was not able to continue using this due to the sulfuric smell. It was not something I could tolerate long enough to get a good idea of quality or effectiveness. Unfortunately, their return policy is extremely limited and only applies for fully priced items. I would highly recommend smelling it on your skin before trying it.

avis.titre: A new staple in my routine
avis.texte: I LOVE using this moisturizer, it's my fave part of my routine. The texture is amazing and hydrating and has made my skin SO much softer. Will definitely be repurchasing!
I absolutely love this product. It leaves my skin feeling incredibly hydrated.

avis.titre: Amazing moisturizer for aging acne prone skin!
avis.texte: I have literally never left a product review but I have to for this moisturizer. I'm 32 years old with oily, acne prone skin and this has been a game changer!! It's light weight but moisturizing, never breaks me out and makes my skin so smooth and radiant. I use this morning and night, after serums and is the perfect base for makeup. I have repurchased several times, this will forever be in my skin care routine.
I heard so many people rave about this product, but I don't think it's anything special. I probably won't repurchase.
Love the texture, but it burns when applied. I've tried using it multiple ways and it still stings.

I bought this a couple weeks ago, it has a really nice texture and feels great to apply! However I'm already out of the bottle after two weeks and I didn't notice any changes to my skin. Not sure I'll be repurchasing.

I should've read the reviews before buying this moisturizer but I was in the store and needed something asap, im happy I did a patch test because it burned so bad, I realized it has Vit C maybe that's what caused my skin to burn? Just one extra star because it's unscented but beware if you have sensitive dry skin!

I've been using this moisturizer for at least a year, and my oily (with surface dryness) acne prone skin does NOT break out! My dry patches feel moisturized and I don't look like an oil-slick by the end of the day. I love that everything is formulated without parabens and cruelty-free. I use the peptide serum with this as well and my skin has never looked better. Please don't stop making this!

avis.titre: A lot of Peeling after Product dries
avis.texte: I received this product the other day with other products i ordered & I was really excited. For some reason after i apply my Retinaldehyde serum, then the multi-peptide advanced serum, & lastly the Multi-Peptide Moisturizer I had really bad peeling when it dried. A lot of peeling not just a tiny bit, it gets in my hair all around my hairline, in my eyebrows, falls into my eye lashes, & my neck in chest peels. I let each product dry in between, before adding another product & I put on a thin layer. I read most reviews & didn't see anyone complaining about this product peeling, I don't understand why mine is. I am Very disappointed, I feel my serums I applied was such a waste bc of this product peeling so bad. It was delivered US mail so I don't know if the cold weather affected it or all 3 of my products from sitting in my mailbox for hours. Is anyone else having this issue?? I hope I can get some answers, my otc drug store brands never peeled. Thank you.
Absolutely love this moisturizer and the packaging. I have combination skin and it's the perfect amount of hydration. Makes my skin look plump and hydrated

I have normal to oily skin and this product is very drying to my skin to the point my skin flakes even when applying a moisturizer over it. Most of the reviews are positive not sure why it doesn't agree with my skin.

love this moisturizer. it worked well on my skin and i definitely felt moisturizered. only down side is how fast it runs out. normally my moisturizers last me well over a month and this one ran out within the month. the product is good, just wish it lasted longer.

I wanted to badly to fall in love with this moisturizer, but I'm simply at a loss. I have tried everything, but no matter what I do, it pills off my face in clumps. I've tried no serums, I've tried with serums, I've tried only using Naturium serums, I've tried with letting my serums dry completely, I've tried leaving my serums a little bit wet. Nothing works. I'm so disappointed.
This is a light moisturizer with a very good combination of ingredients. I repurchased it already and can see myself buying it again.

This moisturizer is SO GOOD. Please don't ever change the formula. It leaves a satin lightweight finish, and it suits my combination skin throughout all season. My skin just appears to be healthy. I'm on my third bottle, and don't feel like looking at other moisturizers!

This is a great peptide moisturizer that is as good as or better than the more expensive ones. Check the ingredients and you will see. It feels good on the skin and works great under foundation. As soon as I run out of my The Ordinary serums I am going to switch to this brand even though it is a little more expensive. I am about done with droppers! Back to peptide moisturizers…there is a drugstore one that is good that is cheaper than this one (ELF Holy Hydration Hydrogel Moisturizer), but if you can't handle fragrance you won't like it.

I absolutely love the naturium moisturizing spf so i thought why not try their moisturizer for night time use . It burned (it was gently burning nothing bad but still )my skin, face and neck ,and make me peel . Im currently looking for a nice moisturizer if anyone has any recommendations.
Purchased for my Granddaughter for Christmas. She uses Naturium for completion because it helps.

It does moisturize but for the price I was expecting better. By no means it it bad but I feel like the formula is a little weak. For how thick the consistency is I was expecting more hydration. I'm trying a second bottle just to see if with consistent use my opinion changes but so far not a must have.

At first, moisturizer seemed semi hydrating, but after a few hours, I looked greasy and shiny and it pilled up, I use this for a few days, and it was the direct cause of large, swollen red under the surface pimples that took a while to get rid of, and would not come to head, after looking at the ingredients, I noticed it's got several poor clogging gradients and is very comedogenic. I wish I would've noticed this sooner because those bombs on my pale face were extremely noticeable even with MAKEUP, which made me feel conscious. I will never understand why they put poor clogging ingredients in products SMFH 🤦🏻‍♀️ DO BETTER COMPANIES & LISTEN TO YOUR CONSUMERS🙄🙄🙄 REVIEWS!!!!!
Not really moisterizing. I felt like my skin had this film on it
I love the way my face feels in the morning when I use this for my nighttime moisturizer. This absorbs well and doesn't end up all over my pillow case 🤣

I think its a great moisturizer if you're more on oily side. I have dry/combo skin and it doesn't feel like it hydrates enough unless I add hydrating serums/toners under in layers, better as a daytime cream imo with ur sunscreen on top as added moisture

This is the 5th tube i have bought and the last 2 moisturizer tubes have felt like they are putting less product in them does not last me as long as before and i really do love this product just wish i wasnt getting less and less product

avis.titre: Love this, but could be better for very dry skin
avis.texte: I'll start off by saying I do really love this moisturizer! It has been the best out of countless others I have tried over the years. Usually whenever I add or switch something in my routine, my skin breaks out before getting used to the new product. With this moisturizer, that did not happen! It has a very nice creamy texture and is great as a day time moisturizer. It feels nice and lightweight on the skin and does not irritate sensitive undereyes. All around great! The only problem I have faced with this moisturizer and all other day time ones, is that it is not moisturizing enough. I have extremely dry skin, so, often I have to put aquaphor on my eyes, nose, and around my mouth on top of my moisturizer for my skin to have a chance of staying hydrated during the day. Nothing wrong with that, just saying if you have very dry skin, don't expect this moisturizer to fix EVERYTHING.

This is lightweight but hydrating. Doesn't irritate my sensitive skin or cause me to breakout. I love that its in a pump bottle. I do see a difference when i use it vs when i dont. It also looks so good as a makeup base. Doesnt make me oily throughout the day and perfect dor day or night. I love that it has amazing ingredients but isn't expensive. It doesnt have a scent which is nice too! It blends easily and sinks in like a nice drink to my skin. Pairs well with other naturium products.

I love this brand and this moisturizer is great. I have combo/dry skin and this is perfect for the summers as it's not too heavy. In the winter I'll layer something thicker on top. Sits well under makeup too - sometimes I can get away without primer.

This is my favorite moisturizer ive ever used. It absorbs into my skin so quickly, is the perfectly consistency/thickness, gives me hydration and a little vitamin c without irritating my sensitive skin, and layers under makeup perfectly.
Love the naturium brand all the products i tried are cery good & affordable 👍 great tgey r now @ Ulta to use my points & coupons. By the way now owned by Elf.

avis.titre: Broke me out so bad in painful bumps
avis.texte: I truly don't know how people use this. I have sensitive skin but I was recommended this product by so many people because it's "sensitive skin safe" what a lie. This stuff broke me out in painful bumps everywhere. it's been over a week and my skin still isn't healed from it, and it hurts. Proceed with caution. Yes I patch tested it.
This is a great daily moisturizer for dry, dehydrated skin! It wears well under makeup & can even be layered with SPF! No pilling or white cast. Helps even flaky, cracked, peeling skin!

It feels like everything is not what they claim it to be sadly. This is worth its weight in gold. It goes on smoothly, it feels nice, it stinks in. Pairs well with foundation. Your skin looks healthy and amazing all day long. I don't know what magic is in this, but it's a need in your skin care regime. That i can at least promise you. I have not been this thrilled in skin care in years. 41 dry skin that looks dehydrated every day with the weather ache ac running non stop. Not any more- My skin looks like a smoothing filter was applied. This off the one!

This is a great basic moisturizer thst has grewt ingredients. Its lightweight but moisturizes and it doesnt break me out. It also looks great under makeup and doesnt have a scent. I love that its in a pump bottle too! Great for travel and your not putting your fingers in.

avis.titre: i've been using this for YEARS!!!
avis.texte: this has been my HG moisturizer for YEARS, esp in the humid climate i live in 365 days a year. my mother, aunt and brother are also ride or dies for this moisturizer. it's super hydrating, nourishing, and the consistency is perfection. i'm so happy that naturium is at ulta now. their eye cream, bha serum, body creams, face wash, spf, peptide serum, and phyto glow balms are also INCREDIBLE!!!
Another great product by Natrium. This moisturizer sinks easily into the skin and seems to hydrate my skin well. I use several different moisturizers but this one is easily one of my regulars.

I'm an avid K-beauty user and usually dislike most western skincare products, but when I saw this I decided to try it on a whim as my daytime moisturizer. . . It's one of the best moisturizers I've ever tried. It's one of the most perfect textures I've ever had the joy of feeling a perfect light cream. It doesn't look or feel heavy. It doesn't leave a greasy glow like 99% of other moisturizers on my skin, but it's still MOISTURIZING? Most cream based moisturizers break me out so I have to stick to purely gel, but this one doesn't break me out? I'm also sensitive to both niacinamide and squalane, but this doesn't break me out either. I'm not sure how they managed to formulate this magical moisturizer but it's a forever repurchase. My one small wish is I hope they make a ceramide moisturizer just like this so I could have a night time moisturizer (but maybe without the niacinamide cause it's hard to find a moisturizer without it).
Goes well with the Multipeptide serum. It's hydrating with a matte finish.
I really like this non-greasy formula. Layers beautifully with tinted moisturizer and a serum.

avis.titre: Gentle, but not special — not deep moisture
avis.texte: I somewhat regret purchasing the jumbo size of this cream, but I will use it up. I chose it because of the peptides but it isn't deeply moisturizing. I feel like I have to rub it in for a while for it to sink into my skin. On the plus side, it's lightweight, has not caused any issues with my sensitive skin, and performs well under makeup with the dimenthicone.

I recently switched to this moisturizer from a hydrogels type moisturizer, and I'm mostly pleased with it. I don't agree that it is "lightweight." Although I won't say it's heavy. It does feel a little greasy until it soaks in. I've been using it for a few weeks now and it does seem to help brighten my skin. I've been using the Naturium gelee cleanser for about 6 months now and it's amazing. But I'm not as amazed by this product. But I do like it. I wish it was a larger size, because I have to use 2 full pumps to feel properly moisturized. I'll keep trying it. I have used other products from this brand and overall, I am pleased and will continue to try new things.

avis.titre: Very pleased with the Peptide moisturizer
avis.texte: This product is new to me and I typically have to watch what I use on my sensitive skin but so far I'm loving this moisturizer. Zero reactions and my skin seems to love it!
Recently started using this moisturizer and I love how soft and smooth it leaves my face and neck.
Feels so luxurious and lightweight and makes my skin look super smooth. Beats all my high end moisturizers by a landslide and the affordable price makes it worth to repurchase.
I love this stuff! Not heavy, plays well with my other skincare items and makeup. Plus my skin is no longer dry. At all!
I wanted so much to like this product but it didn't work well with my dry skin. It also caused some irritation

This peptide cream is amazing and if my skin wasn't so temperamental I'd rate is a 5 out of 5. I have pcos, and that reflects in how dry and irritated my skin can get. In the summer time this moisturizer leaves my face hydrated and not flaky, however its just not enough right now during this MN winter season. I still love this product nonetheless and have it receive it on auto ship.

avis.titre: Did not realize vit c was in it
avis.texte: I've been breaking out and not realizing why and last night i just realized there's vitamin c in this product . Most products that have actives in there, it is stated more clearly but i should read better also
I use this at night along with the marshmallow barrier cream. I like it so far and feels silky onnthe skin

I am not one to write reviews but as I was finishing my nighttime skincare routine, I noticed how the pump in this tube is squeezing every last bit of product out of the tool. The tube is really this flat on its OWN with only the pump! No wasted products here. Aside from the amazing engineering of the tube, it has done wonders for my skin. I was on medical grade skincare for years and recently switched to more affordable products.. because.. well, this stuff gets expensive! After watching Sam on TikTok, I decided to give naturium a go and I noticed no difference (thus far, 3-4 months in) in the quality between naturium & other popular medical skincare brands. Purchasing more now!!

Great ingredients, no fragrance and overall a nice feeling moisturizer. Glad I purchased this after seeing a makeup artist use this on YouTube. Leaves no greasy feeling and really hydrates my skin. I love the simplistic but high end feel to the packaging. I have to enjoy using a product if I'm going to stick with a brand and for such a reasonable price I'm glad I have tried Naturium.

avis.titre: Might not be good for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have sensitive dry skin and this caused redness and irritation but the worst part is it causes my eyes to swell when I tried it both times. I did a test spot on the back of my hand and after a full day it was fine so I though I'd out it in my face at night just to test it out for the first time with 2 pumps. My eyes started to burn and literally swell up, I woke up looking like a hot mess and needed to ice my eyes. The following day I thought I'd try half a pump and mix it with my regular moisturizer and to stay clear of my eye area to see if that would help. Unfortunately it did not and I still had to take a Claritin and my eyes still swelled up.

I have dry skin and always used to heavy morning moisturizer. This is different. It's so creamy and luxurious when applied but dries down perfectly, not greasy or oily. I tried it as a base under makeup and it worked really nicely.
Really like this moisturizer -- goes on very smooth, feels great on my face and my skin feel moisturized throughout the day

This moisturizer is great. It goes on great, but doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy. I find that I don't have to use a ton of it during the summer since my other naturium products moisturize my skin. But I love it so much I tend to reach for it at night and then put it back for my plant based ceramide cream.

Great price for such goodness for my face. Usually when I apply moisturizer I get an initial redness and then it goes away. I get no redness at all from applying this multi peptides moisturizer to my face. I have to however learn when it comes to my face stick to one and one being just this one. It's great. I highly recommend it and the eye cream too. Get both

I've been using this for a minute and cannot honestly tell if it's doing anything. Eye creams are usually kind of unnecessary as an extra - a moisturizer will do - but I like the feel, it's not too sticky, and it works under my Dieux eye masks so it's a nice little ritual.
I enjoy this moisturizer. Gentle for sensitive skin and doesn't seem to clog my pores. I use this at night.

I bought this to use after applying the Mandelic Acid 12% serum and the Niacinamide/Zinc serum. I love how compatible it is with my skin and how light it feels. It is not greasy and leaves my skin feeling a bit tighter and so soft. I only have 4 stars because it does make my skin a bit oily a few hours after applying; however, I could have simply bought the wrong product for my skin. I will continue to use this, but may need to research for a moisturizer that is lighter weight. Naturium customer service has described this as a mid-weight formula.
Feels great on the skin. Not too thick that it feels heavy but still feels nourishing for the skin.

Smooooth texture, good silky moisture. Addressed some fine lines within initial few weeks, and then I did notice a good amount of tone evening. It did become a teensy bit too heavy for summer daytime wear. Works very well with my cosrx mucin, but prone to pilling when used in conjunction with Niaicinamide gel cream 5% but ONLY if I messed with it too much! Again, first skincare empty, and I WILL be back.

I've purchased this many times because of how reliable it is. I have dry skin, so I use this in the morning since it is a bit lighter. I think it would work great for oily skin as well! It leaves my skin feeling so smooth.

This moisturizer has transformed my skin and it has gave me noticeable results that motivate and makes me excited to do my skin care routine 💕 I had lines of expression on my forehead that are now technically gone and my skin is becoming glass.

I picked this up a couple of months ago on a whim looking to try a new moisturizer with some purported anti aging benefits. It is very okay. I see no visible improvement in my skin and to be honest, my skin looks a bit worse than before. It doesn't moisturize very deeply at all which has resulted in my skin feeling dry more often. My skin texture is not as even as it was with my previous moisturizer which claimed no similar benefits. Overall it is certainly one of the moisturizers of all time. But truly nothing special. I'm not convinced it is capable of doing anything it claims to. Kind of a shame.
This moisturizer has changed my skin. I recommend it to everyone. It is nourishing, but not heavy, and lays beautifully under makeup!
I loved it from the first moment that I used it. It's perfect for daily use.

In a world where high-quality skincare products often come with a hefty price tag, this moisturizer stands out as a wallet-friendly option that doesn't compromise on results.
